title: Hegseth: 'We didn't start this war but under President Trump we're finishing it'
summary: The remarks are the first to reporters since the U.S.-Israeli military operations against Iran began Saturday despite weeks of talks designed to stave off a conflict.
contentText:
His remarks are the first public ones to reporters since the U.S.-Israeli military operations against Iran began Saturday despite weeks of talks designed to stave off a conflict.

(Image credit: Andrew Harnik)
